description: Potencial solar en España is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG). Representation of the solar potential calculated for the entire territory. This information is extracted from the processing of the 2m grid Digital Surface Model, by applying different calculation algorithms, mainly r.sun. Coverage: Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG). The portal shows the English title as "Solar potential in Spain" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG). Its keywords include Paneles, Cubiertas, Energética. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WMTS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
